faces.name: Zinnia, Born for the Stage
faces.oracleText:
Flying, haste
Whenever Zinnia attacks, exile up to one other target creature, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.
At the beginning of each opponent's combat, you may have them gain control of Zinnia until end of turn. If you do, untap Zinnia and goad them.
